## Notes

- The probe is read-only and bypasses the fetcher entirely; no Redis writes, no config mutation, no registry change. Pre-integration validation only.
- Active-tick depth follows Uniswap V3 §6.2.2 formula:
  - `amount0_token = L × (sqrtPrice_upper − sqrtPrice_current) × Q96 / (sqrtPrice_current × sqrtPrice_upper) / 10^dec0`
  - `amount1_token = L × (sqrtPrice_current − sqrtPrice_lower) / Q96 / 10^dec1`
  - USD valuation: token1 (USDT) ≈ $1; token0 (WETH) at current ETH price from sqrtPriceX96.
- Same-block enforcement is the standard project mandate (cross-block spreads are 5–14× inflated and invalid).
- This report describes a **pre-integration** measurement: the surface never appeared in `surfaces/registry.json` and the pools were never added to the master-fetcher config.

## Structural Insight (for the broader Wave 2 thesis)

```
ETH/USDT on arbitrum venue ecosystem at probe time (2026-05-30):
  uniswap_v3   — present, deep
  camelot_v3   — present, structurally dust (this probe)
  sushiswap_v3 — present, $84.5k TVL (Candidate B; would require its own probe)
  ramses_v2    — not present on this pair (skipped)

USDT is the orphan stable leg on arbitrum: most arb venues either don't
list ETH/USDT or hold it only nominally. This is a chain-level finding
worth noting — it predicts that *any* arbitrum ETH/USDT counterpart will
need separate probe validation before integration. Sushiswap is the only
remaining Priority 1 counterpart for this pair.
```
